entities.name: Boc deprotection of aryl piperazine
observations: The reactant is a Boc-protected aryl piperazine and the product is the corresponding N-deprotected piperazine.
The aryl sulfone and aromatic framework are retained during the transformation.
An exact/near-exact ORD precedent is ord-1510089128a24f74812b6a46ec7cb605.

entities.name: HCl in 1,3-dioxolane
observations: Hydrochloric acid in 1,3-dioxolane is directly supported for removal of the Boc group from this aryl piperazine.
The product may be obtained as the hydrochloride salt after concentration or workup.
Reaction time, temperature, and isolated yield were not available in the returned record.

entities.name: Trifluoroacetic acid
observations: TFA is a plausible alternative acid for Boc deprotection, commonly used in dichloromethane or a related solvent; it is an inferred alternative, not the exact ORD-supported condition.
